IF either breaks, funding holds at $4,000 and the break-stop's live performance becomes the study. Do not change behavior to chase this — it grades itself.

OPERATOR CONFIRMS your own top precondition as binding: no new funding round until (a) sector fields are populated by the real pipeline and (b) size_upside_book's 40% correlation-cluster cap is wired to see them. The PAY+QTWO cluster reading (one factor, ~37% of equity) stands as the motivating exhibit. No new capital to the sleeve; next round funds from the book.

IF deluxe holds AND gauntlet_v6's intersection keeps winning its forward test, intersection-N25 becomes a documented spec-change candidate for the January rebalance. Spec unchanged until then.
